definitions.ratio: Mean across monthly MAE / interpolation MAE on the identical context subset
definitions.weights: Fixed per test fold, selected on preceding-month days1-15; used for all inputs/quantile levels
definitions.winner: Hindsight winner among six experts for each whole zone/hour; not a deployable router
definitions.shape: Flat if max absolute neighboring slope is below fitting-history 25th percentile; otherwise peak/trough/rising/falling
